# Supabase browser dependency

`supabase-2.57.4.js` is the unchanged UMD bundle from the npm package `@supabase/supabase-js@2.57.4`. PC and mobile load this same local file before creating their client, so a CDN failure cannot remove the sign-in dependency.

License: MIT, reproduced in `supabase-LICENSE.txt`.
